description_en: Queries the Static Page Caching configuration of websites
description_zh: 查询网站业务静态页面缓存的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-cache-configs --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domains www.aliyundoc.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeWebCacheConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: An array consisting of domain names for which you want to query the Static Page Caching configurations
parameters.help_zh: 要查询静态页面缓配置的域名列表
parameters.name: domains
